verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The fresh pull-list revalidation now runs only when terminal-reap candidates exist, only for repositories holding candidates, and each repository read is independently guarded. A refused listing withdraws that repository's candidates from both terminal confirmation and `dead_claims`, retaining their leases fail-closed while allowing other repositories and ordinary dead claims to proceed. The new call-sequenced fixture proves the initial snapshot succeeds before the later listing fails, checks cross-repository progress, retained versus released claims, systemic all-refused reporting after work, and the no-candidate request path. The associated fresh-issue, snapshot, and attempt-budget handling is consistently fail-closed and has non-vacuous behavioral coverage. I found no blocker, major, or lower-severity defect in the diff.
